articles.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state
articles.summary: Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. articles.title: Race to replant five South African baobabs after export blocked
articles.summary: The trees, intended for an unnamed buyer in Georgia, were reportedly dug up without the necessary permits Environmentalists in South Africa are racing to replant five centuries-old baobabs after the 20-tonne trees were dug up by an exporter, who tried to ship them thousands of miles to Georgia. articles.title: Doug Morrison obituary
articles.summary: My friend and colleague Doug Morrison, who has died aged 83 from Parkinson’s-related pneumonia, was one of the Guardian’s key production journalists from the 1980s until the 2000s. He was a workmate revered for cool leadership under testing circumstances, not least during many technological changes and redesigns. He also wrote articles against apartheid while living…

articles.title: Stella Cherfas obituary
articles.summary: My friend Stella Cherfas, who has died aged 101, helped popularise yoga in Britain through her classes that spanned several decades. She was a well-known fixture in many of London’s community spaces, notably teaching free weekly classes at Covent Garden Community Centre’s Seven Dials Club.
